units.source_text: 又思考了那么长时间，真不好办……

en.t: And after thinking for such a long time, this is really hard to handle...

units.source_text: 看样子要出败着，要出问题啦。”

en.t: It looks as though a losing move is coming, and trouble is about to arise.

units.source_text: 大竹七段竭力控制起伏的心潮。

en.t: Otake 7-dan did his utmost to control the surge of emotion in his heart.

units.source_text: 他用时一小时四十四分长考，于下午三时四十三分下黑121封盘。

en.t: After a long think that took one hour and forty-four minutes, he played Black 121 at 3:43 p.m. and sealed the game.
